name: clonamic
description: Clonamic skills for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Grok.

plugins.name: clonamic-code
plugins.description: Evidence-based modular design: library-style modules with single responsibilities, explicit contracts, and migration order.

plugins.name: clonamic-data
plugins.description: Dataset and Hugging Face workflow guidance: proportional pre-flight, streaming, validation, private publishing.

plugins.name: clonamic-design
plugins.description: UI design direction, UI review, real-browser QA, visual art, and hand-drawn diagrams that run on the host's own tools.

plugins.name: clonamic-documents
plugins.description: Office documents built with the host's own tools: Korean HWPX editing with a structure validator, and editable PPTX decks with render-based QA.

plugins.name: clonamic-executor
plugins.description: One bounded, read-only request through an installed agent CLI (Claude, Grok, or Hermes).

plugins.name: clonamic-git
plugins.description: Git commits, PRs, tags, and release notes under the user's own identity with no AI attribution trailers, footers, or bot authors.

plugins.name: clonamic-harness
plugins.description: Stage-by-stage working discipline for AI coding agents: read the request exactly, gate persistent changes behind at most two Korean approvals (작업명세서 only while intent is unsynced, then 개발명세서), add agents such as an independent reviewer only when they pay off, and finish with fresh-evidence verification and an outcome-first 보고서.

plugins.name: clonamic-korean
plugins.description: Write and revise natural Korean documents (resumes, portfolios, reports, posts, docs) with one explicit /clonamic-korean command that keeps facts, numbers, quotes, and the author's voice fixed.

plugins.name: clonamic-memory
plugins.description: Explicit local store, recall, forget, link, and bounded graph operations.
